_comment: PRISM v3.1+ centrally-managed guard policy. Place at ~/.claude/prism-policy.json (rename, drop _ prefix from keys you want active). Hooks read this BEFORE checking env vars. User escape: set PRISM_POLICY_OVERRIDE=1 to flip precedence so env wins. Session-start emits one-time notice when policy is detected.

guards._mutation: soft | hard | off — controls prism-mutation-guard.mjs (default: hard)
guards._dispatch: soft | hard | off — controls prism-parent-dispatch-guard.mjs (default: hard)
guards._model: soft | hard | strict | off — controls prism-agent-model-guard.mjs (v2.9.1 semantics; default: soft)
guards._tier_advisor: soft | hard | off — controls prism-task-tier-advisor.mjs (default: soft)
guards._safety: soft | hard | off — controls prism-safety.mjs Bash patterns (default: hard; off NOT recommended)
guards._parallel: soft | hard | off — v3.1 prism-parallel-guard.mjs (default: soft)
guards._panel: soft | hard | off — v3.1 prism-panel-guard.mjs hallucination detection (default: soft)
guards._skill_trigger: soft | hard | off — v3.1 prism-skill-trigger-guard.mjs (default: soft)

team_id: _team-name (optional) — sets default team_id for new agents created via agent-factory

telemetry._opt_in: false (default) | true — controls /prism-telemetry aggregation; LOCAL only as of v3.1, no network

_precedence: policy file > env var > hook default. Set PRISM_POLICY_OVERRIDE=1 to flip (env wins).
